display.purpose: Page titles and major settings headers.

body.purpose: Dense operational copy and markdown preview.

label.purpose: Controls, chips, counters, and path metadata.

motion.name: progress-scale
motion.purpose: Progress bar changes without layout animation.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action for saves, imports, and confirmed operations.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 32px; padding: 6px 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font: 500 14px/1.4 'JetBrains Mono Variable', monospace; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 80%, var(--background)); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action for test, clear, and non-destructive branches.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { height: 32px; padding: 6px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); font: 500 14px/1.4 'JetBrains Mono Variable', monospace; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--muted); color: var(--foreground); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Compact field for paths, tokens, model names, and search.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 32px; width: 100%; min-width: 0; padding: 4px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--input); border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground); font: 400 14px/1.4 'JetBrains Mono Variable', monospace; transition: border-color 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ring); outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Skill Card
components.description: Reusable card for a skill row or grid item.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--card); color: var(--card-foreground); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 8%, transparent); transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-card:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 30%, var(--card)); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 25%, var(--border)); } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0 0 4px; font: 600 14px/1.4 'JetBrains Mono Variable', monospace; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted-foreground); font: 400 12px/1.6 'JetBrains Mono Variable', monospace; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Main shell navigation with active target state.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 6px 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--sidebar-foreground); font: 500 14px/1.4 'JetBrains Mono Variable', monospace; text-align: left; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--sidebar-accent); color: var(--sidebar-accent-foreground); } .ds-nav-item-active { background: var(--sidebar-primary); color: var(--sidebar-primary-foreground); } .ds-nav-count { margin-left: auto; border-radius: 999px; padding: 2px 6px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--sidebar-primary-foreground) 15%, transparent); color: inherit; font-size: 10px; }

components.name: Selected Chip
components.description: Selected filter or category state without relying on color alone.
components.css: .ds-chip-selected { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 32px; padding: 6px 12px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 70%, var(--border)); border-radius: 999px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 15%, transparent); color: var(--primary); font: 600 12px/1.4 'JetBrains Mono Variable', monospace; } .ds-chip-selected:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: SkillPort should feel like a calm control surface for local filesystem work. The interface is dense, explicit, and reviewable. Visual polish serves trust; it never hides where a skill lives, which target is active, or which action will touch disk or network.
keyCharacteristics: Compact enough for daily expert workflows.
State-rich through tokens, not raw color patches.
Familiar desktop controls with clear focus and disabled states.
Windows-first, with local data boundaries made visible.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: One chosen Catppuccin accent owns primary action, selection, focus, and progress. Do not add a second decorative accent to the same surface.

rules.name: The Contrast Before Preference Rule
rules.body: In Latte, every primary accent must meet WCAG AA text contrast before it can appear on a filled control.

rules.name: The Token Only Rule
rules.body: Use semantic tokens for UI color. Raw black, raw white, raw rgba overlays, and one-off stripe accents are forbidden.

rules.name: The Console Legibility Rule
rules.body: Use weight and spacing for hierarchy. Do not introduce display fonts or oversized marketing type.

rules.name: The Flat At Rest Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Use borders and tonal layers first; shadows only explain stacking or interaction state.

dos: Do keep filesystem paths, targets, install destinations, and network side effects visible before action.
Do use Catppuccin semantic tokens for backgrounds, foregrounds, borders, rings, and actions.
Do keep expert density, but preserve touchable controls on narrow windows.
Do use full borders, background tint, icon state, or weight changes for selected list items.
Do keep animations short, stateful, and transform or opacity based.
Do use i18n for every user-visible string.
donts: Don't look like a generic SaaS dashboard, a marketplace landing page, or a decorative AI-themed command center.
Don't use hero metrics, ornamental gradients, glass cards, vague empty states, or hidden background automation for reviewable operations.
Don't use side-stripe borders as card, list, callout, or alert accents.
Don't use raw black, raw white, or raw rgba overlays in product UI.
Don't animate width, height, max-width, left, right, top, or bottom.
Don't rely on color alone for status. Pair it with labels, icons, or structure.
